_meta.batch: Examine - lokacja CabinetOfCuriosity/Gabinet Osobliwosci (60 terminow, ~19 mikroscen) - kolekcja Doktora Zephyra: sfera armilarna, woskowa figura 'Boggy' (bagienny potwor - powtarzajacy sie motyw z SUS X), kula do wrozenia, hipnotyzujace szkielko, oraz - kluczowo - Jezyk Syreny widoczny za szklem (MermaidsTongue1-2).
_meta.speaker_resolution: speaker_map.json NIE POKRYWA kategorii Examine. Mowcy przypisani na podstawie kontekstu/tresci.

Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_Mer.en: ...is that what I think it is?
Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_Mer.pl: ...czy to jest to, co myślę, że jest?
Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_Mer.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_Mer.en: ...I want to take a closer look at it, but it's locked behind glass.
Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_Mer.pl: ...chcę przyjrzeć się temu bliżej, ale jest zamknięte za szkłem.
Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_Mer.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_Puz.en: There's a bunch of little skulls down here...
Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_Puz.pl: Jest tu na dole kilka małych czaszek...
Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_Puz.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_arm.en: Usually the rings are set around the earth, or the sun...
Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_arm.pl: Zwykle pierścienie są ułożone wokół ziemi albo słońca...
Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_arm.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_arm.en: ...but this one has a little clawed foot in the centre?
Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_arm.pl: ...ale ta ma pośrodku małą łapę ze szponami?
Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_arm.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_arm.en: I... don't have the mental capacity to consider the implications of that.
Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_arm.pl: Ja... nie mam siły psychicznej, żeby zastanawiać się nad konsekwencjami tego.
Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_arm.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_bg/.en:
It's not a cabinet.
It's a whole dang [h]room.[/h]
Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_bg/.pl:
To nie jest gabinet.
To cały, cholerny [h]pokój.[/h]
Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_bg/.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_bg/.en:
Eh, almost.
It's more like a... walk-in pantry.
Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_bg/.pl:
Eh, prawie.
To bardziej jak... duża spiżarnia.
Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_bg/.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_bog.en: Yeah it's Boggy. The swamp monster from Boggy's Bog-
Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_bog.pl: Tak, to Boggy. Bagienny potwór z Bagna Boggy'ego-
Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_bog.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_bog.en: Don't panic, it's just a wax model.
Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_bog.pl: Bez paniki, to tylko woskowa figura.
Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_bog.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_bog.en: We can't seem to get away from this guy...
Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_bog.pl: Chyba nie da się uciec od tego faceta...
Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_bog.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_cry.en: On a normal day, that'd be worth a look.
Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_cry.pl: W normalny dzień warto by się temu przyjrzeć.
Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_cry.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_cry.en: But I think we've already hit our crystal ball capacity.
Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_cry.pl: Ale chyba osiągnęliśmy już nasz limit kul do wróżenia.
Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_cry.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_hyp.en: ...but I can't seem to look away...
Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_hyp.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_hyp.en: I don't know what this is...
Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_hyp.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_nos.en:
But if you laid it down flat...
You could use it as a sundial.
Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_nos.pl:
Ale gdybyś położył to płasko...
Mógłbyś użyć tego jako zegara słonecznego.
Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_nos.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_pri.en: This looks like one of those metal masks they used to make prisoners wear.
Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_pri.pl: To wygląda jak jedna z tych metalowych masek, które kiedyś zakładano więźniom.
Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_pri.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_uni.en:
Slow down.
Could just be a narwhal.
Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_uni.pl:
Zwolnij.
Może to być po prostu narwal.
Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_uni.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_uni.en: A narwhal's horn is on the [i]end[/i] of its nose!
Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_uni.pl: Róg narwala jest na [i]końcu[/i] jego nosa!
Examine/Exam_Area_CabinetOfCuriosity_uni.speaker: Sally
